note: Utgangspunkt for designprofiler i KI-bildeassistenten. Feltene brukes i bildepromptene (engelsk). KI kan foreslå en profil ut fra emnets innhold, og alt kan endres per emne.

styles.label: Moderne 3D-illustrasjoner
styles.description: Myke 3D-former, rolig lys og en vennlig, moderne stil.
styles.illustration_style: modern soft 3D illustration, clean rendered shapes, subtle materials, friendly and professional
styles.palette_description: calm blues with one warm accent, light neutral surroundings
styles.contrast: clear separation between subject and background, WCAG-friendly contrast for important shapes
styles.lighting: soft studio lighting from the upper left, gentle shadows
styles.composition: one clear focal point, generous negative space, subject slightly off-centre, uncluttered
styles.background: simple light neutral background with a subtle gradient
styles.detail_level: medium detail; only details that support the concept
styles.visual_traits: rounded forms, consistent camera angle slightly above eye level, cohesive colour accents
styles.people: diverse, realistic proportions, adult students and teachers in a Nordic higher-education setting

styles.label: Minimalistisk flat design
styles.description: Flate former, få farger og tydelige silhuetter.
styles.illustration_style: minimalist flat vector-style illustration, geometric shapes, no gradients or textures
styles.palette_description: muted teal and deep blue-green with a sand accent on an off-white base
styles.contrast: high contrast between flat colour areas
styles.lighting: no realistic lighting; flat colour fields with minimal shading
styles.composition: balanced, centred or rule-of-thirds layout with lots of white space
styles.background: plain off-white or very light tint
styles.visual_traits: consistent line weight, simplified figures without facial detail, limited palette

styles.label: Realistisk fotografisk stil
styles.description: Naturlig fotolignende uttrykk fra relevante læringssituasjoner.
styles.illustration_style: photorealistic editorial photograph, natural and authentic, documentary feel
styles.palette_description: natural, slightly desaturated colours with warm daylight tones
styles.contrast: natural contrast, subject clearly in focus
styles.composition: shallow depth of field, eye-level perspective, one clear subject or interaction
styles.background: realistic but calm learning environments, softly blurred
styles.detail_level: high realism, but no distracting objects
styles.visual_traits: consistent colour grading across images, candid moments rather than posed stock photos
styles.people: fictional, diverse adult students and staff in a Nordic university setting

styles.label: Akademiske illustrasjoner
styles.description: Saklig, presis lærebokstil med rolig fargebruk.
styles.illustration_style: academic textbook illustration, precise and neutral, fine linework with restrained colour
styles.palette_description: restrained navy and grey with a terracotta highlight on warm paper white
styles.contrast: high legibility of shapes and relationships
styles.composition: clear, didactic layout; elements arranged to show relationships and sequence
styles.detail_level: precise where it matters for understanding, otherwise sparse
styles.visual_traits: consistent line weight, scientific accuracy, calm and serious tone
styles.people: neutral, realistic proportions when people are needed

styles.label: Isometriske illustrasjoner
styles.description: Isometrisk perspektiv som viser systemer, rom og prosesser.
styles.illustration_style: clean isometric illustration, 30-degree isometric projection, crisp edges
styles.palette_description: indigo and cyan with an orange accent on a pale grey-blue base
styles.contrast: distinct planes with clear light and shadow sides
styles.lighting: consistent light from the top left, soft ambient occlusion
styles.composition: elements arranged on an isometric grid, showing structure and flow
styles.visual_traits: consistent isometric angle, modular objects, tidy spacing

styles.label: Infografisk stil
styles.description: Visuelle forklaringer med symboler, flyt og korte etiketter der de hjelper.
styles.illustration_style: infographic-style explanatory illustration using icons, arrows, shapes and visual flow; text only as short labels where they aid understanding
styles.palette_description: deep teal family with an amber accent, high clarity
styles.contrast: strong contrast for icons and connectors
styles.composition: left-to-right or top-to-bottom visual flow that reflects the correct order of the process
styles.visual_traits: consistent icon style, rounded connectors, clear grouping
